links.outcome: Agent completeness and timeliness of critical actions in simulated ED shift
links.effect: Current agents reach correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap.
links.quote: On CES, current agents reach the correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap.

unlisted_practices: Self-evolving harness that rewrites the agent operating manual between shifts from trace-level feedback
Externalized clinical skills library for high-stakes regimen knowledge
Isolated subagents partitioning per-turn decisions across patient queue

screen.reason: The paper simulates long-horizon emergency department shifts to measure agentic execution failures and tests an adaptive harness/scaffolding safeguard framework (Asclepius) designed to mitigate instruction-adherence drift and execution gaps.

primary.practice: adaptive agent harness and architectural scaffolding
